provenance.source_quote: DDPAI Z100 Master power draw figures at 12.6v, no cloud. all testing done with the DC009 hardwire cable: Driving mode, 2CH front/telephoto: 435 mA; timelapse parking mode: 282 mA; collision detection parking mode (idle): 52 mA; collision detection parking mode (recording): 424 mA

scope: All four readings use the same owner configuration: 12.6 V, no cloud, DC009 hardwire cable. Driving is explicitly 2CH front/telephoto; active views in each parking state are unreported.
derivation: power_w = Decimal(voltage_v) * Decimal(current_ma) / Decimal(1000); source supplies current, not watts.
historical_claim_note: Measured collision monitoring is 52 mA at 12.6 V = 0.6552 W. The earlier owner-relayed 135 mW (0.135 W) claim is not a measured row and does not establish equivalent test conditions. Existing client-only custom claim links are unchanged.

measurements.voltage_source: Owner explicitly reports 12.6 V test supply
measurements.notes: Owner-supplied current only; watts derived exactly as 12.6 V × mA / 1000. No cloud; DC009 hardwire cable. Same owner test configuration as the explicitly 2CH front/telephoto driving test; active parking views not separately established. Firmware, HDR, quality, parking capture FPS/SPF, lighting, meter hardware and startup/wake timings unreported. No settings or timing inferred from video cohorts.
